name: BKV Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, BKV Industries Ltd is in the aquaculture business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
BKVIL is promoted by Bommidala (BKV) Group, 
which are known for tobacco exports. The company is engaged in the aquaculture business. Currently, it has an integrated 35-acre aquaculture farm for shrimp production, which it has given on long-term lease, and except for the
 lease income, the company has not been carrying any other commercial operations. It employed only five employees during the year, which included the Managing Director.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.54 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.07% over last 3 years.
